news.title: Fed watchdog finds renovation failures, but no grounds for criminal referral
news.summary: The long-awaited report by the Fed's inspector general said it found no reasonable grounds to believe federal criminal law had been violated. The report was released on Tuesday.

news.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
news.summary: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack. Anthropic and OpenAI have not commented on the investigation.

news.title: DOJ accuses Minnesota federal judges of misconduct for NY Times immigration interviews
news.summary: The Department of Justice seeks the recusal of the judges who spoke to The New York Times from any cases involving the Department of Homeland Security.

news.title: Medicare Advantage plans will be cheaper next year. Here’s the new cost.
news.summary: Medicare beneficiaries can change their coverage during open enrollment. Open enrollment begins Oct. 15 and runs through Dec. 15. For more information, visit Medicare.gov/OpenEnrollment.
